items.item_text: Bachelor's degree in business administration, public administration or related area. (Required)

Prepares, manages and administers business contracts agreements, and procurement documents to support policies from the Regents of the University of California and the local campus administration of such policies, as needed. Works with University Stakeholders and Supply Chain Team Members on UC policy compliance, reporting and training as needed to support procurement.

Utilizes professional knowledge and expertise to effectively prepare, negotiate and execute complex contract documents working closely with internal stakeholders, core lab managers, non profits, K – 12 school districts, other universities, and corporations to effectively develop and incorporate appropriate contract terms and detailed scope of services as appropriate to maximize the value and potential performance of each contract for the University of California, Merced.
Provides management and administrative support to the Division of Finance and Administration and other campus departments as needs may arise.
3 years of demonstrated professional procurement/contracting experience or paralegal project management experience, or 7 years of equivalent experience/education/training. (Required)
Thorough knowledge of internal departmental / unit operating policies, applicable state and federal regulations and general contract terms.
Strong knowledge of the organization, including its infrastructure, goals, mission, rules, policies, guidelines, etc. (Preferred)
Thorough knowledge and understanding of specific contracting assignments.
Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communications skills; and ability to deal effectively with broad and diverse constituencies ensuring strong customer service orientation and skills.
Strong organizational, presentation and negotiation skills.
Strong listening and political acumen skills.
